newsitem.title: USA: Rouse to redeem all Series A preferred shrs.
newsitem.headline: Rouse to redeem all Series A preferred shrs.

text.p: The Rouse Co said Friday it has exercised its option to redeem all its outstanding Series A Convertible Preferred Stock.

Holders of the Series A Preferred Stock will receive 2.3529 shares of Rouse common stock for each share of Series A Preferred Stock, of which there were 3.96 million shares outstanding as of August 28.
The Series A Preferred Stock was initially issued in February of 1993 at $50 per share with a dividend of $3.25 per share per year.
The Rouse Company's common stock has a current annual dividend rate of $0.88 per share, and it closed at $26.125 on Thursday.

The redemption date will be Monday, Sept. 30. Shares of Series A Preferred Stock may be converted into shares of common at the Conversion Price of $21.25 per share (or 2.3529 shares of common stock for each share of Series A Preferred Stock) at any time prior to 1700 EDT September 30.
